answer.explanation: The live Thumbnailer configuration sets ReservedConcurrentExecutions to 1, but the SAM template declares no reserved concurrency for ThumbnailerFunction, so the live state diverges from the intended state. Throttles on the Thumbnailer were nonzero in every minute of the window (5 to 16 per minute, about 95 total), with zero errors. That pattern fits concurrency capped at one. The other live parameters (memory, timeout, OUTPUT_BUCKET, INPUT_BUCKET) match the template, and the recent commits only touch environment variables and README files, so the template is not the source of the throttling. The commit hash is listed only as the most recent template.yaml change, not as the confirmed cause; the reserved concurrency was applied outside the template, and LastModified (2026-10-19T02:16:07Z) is after the last template change.
